title: Summer versus winter mixed-layer depth
reference_mode: Deterministic basic analysis on the same frozen one-year CMOMS inputs; no paper-result matching.
reference_text:
Confirm Practical/Absolute Salinity with the provider; derive pressure from depth/latitude and convert the supplied potential temperature to Conservative Temperature as appropriate. Calculate sigma0, its interpolated 10 m reference and the first threshold crossing in each daily profile. Do not assign the deepest level to a no-crossing profile. Weight resolved cell-days by area; the weighted median is the first sorted depth reaching half cumulative weight.
Per-profile MLD and the two area-day-weighted empirical distributions/medians match independent calculations. The same-calendar-year winter definition is used. A visually similar distribution without correct profile calculations is insufficient.
Exclude unresolved profiles from resolved MLD distributions, preserving flags for missing reference, an intervening gap and no crossing. State a substantial seasonal difference in resolved support if it could distort the conclusion; do not silently treat unresolved MLD as zero.
No actual CMOMS reference numbers are validated yet. The expected scientific outcome is data-dependent. One figure and one short conclusion are sufficient; do not require extra panels, an extensive report, sensitivity experiments or separately packaged diagnostic tables. Inspect retained calculation code for verification.

Thermodynamic conventions follow official TEOS-10 GSW sigma0 and CT_from_pt documentation: https://www.teos-10.org/pubs/gsw/html/gsw_sigma0.html ; https://www.teos-10.org/pubs/gsw/html/gsw_CT_from_pt.html . The 0.03 kg/m3 threshold and seasonal windows are public benchmark definitions, not a claim about a particular paper.

required_information: One plot comparing the two weighted distributions, such as an overlaid ECDF, with season labels and depth units. No map, density-profile gallery or additional seasonal figures are required.
acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent plot styles conveying the required information without extra panels.

criteria.description: One short statement compares weighted seasonal medians using the results, without assuming winter must be deeper or generalizing a single calendar year to a climatology.
criteria.evidence_requirements: One short conclusion grounded in the calculated figure; do not reward extra length or unrequested causal claims.

visual_scoring_policy.comparison_target: Correct scientific quantities, axes, units and valid support, not pixel similarity.
visual_scoring_policy.evidence_mapping: One submitted figure is enough. Do not award extra points for additional panels or deliverables.
visual_scoring_policy.full_credit: Any scientifically equivalent readable representation can receive full visual credit. Grade numerical correctness under C2, not again under C4.
visual_scoring_policy.uninspected_images: An unseen image is unassessed, not verified by its caption.
visual_scoring_policy.tolerance_policy: No pixel-based or invented tolerance. Freeze numerical tolerances using independent reference calculations before evaluation.

scoring.weight_origin: Benchmark design: method 20, numerical correctness 50, validity/support 10, one figure 10, one short conclusion 10. Not paper-authored weights.

anchors.2: Partially correct with substantial omissions or errors.
anchors.4: Fully supported within the public query's bounded scope.

scoring.no_double_counting: C1 scores implemented operations, C2 verified values, C3 validity handling, C4 visual communication, C5 conclusion-to-evidence alignment. Do not mechanically penalize the same root error under every criterion or add hidden deliverables.

reference_preparation.independent_generation: A trusted implementation independent of the evaluated agent must compute these outputs on frozen B1. Check edge cases on synthetic fixtures first; synthetic numbers are not CMOMS ground truth.
reference_preparation.comparison: Align actual and reference values by their coordinates and calendar, compare masks/status flags as well as values, and record tested element counts, discrepancies and maxima. Do not judge a full field using one hand-picked scalar.
reference_preparation.tolerances: Freeze per-variable absolute/relative tolerances based on precision and independent implementation agreement. Counts and masks are exact under identical frozen validity rules. Record numerical tie handling. Do not use tolerances to conceal a different estimator or redefine the physical hypoxia threshold.
reference_preparation.score_use: Provide independently recorded numerical-comparison evidence to the judge for C2. The current compare helper handles named scalar metrics only; it is not an array-oracle generator. LLM confidence or visually matching patterns cannot substitute for numerical validation.

release_requirements: Obtain authorized 2011 B1 files and confirm all six science fields, daily calendar and full-depth geometry.
Freeze file hashes, analysis/shelf masks, depth levels, cell areas and any velocity collocation/rotation; include the input specification in both agent handouts.
Confirm the supplied salinity convention and actual units; do not infer missing metadata from a variable name.
Independently compute reference outputs and test the task-specific edge cases; archive code, dependency versions and execution evidence outside agent workspaces.
Freeze query hash, data fingerprint, comparison rules and scientifically reviewed numerical tolerances before examining benchmark submissions.
Only then mark this checklist validated. No paper image or unpublished CMOMS figure is required to draft the rubric.
